llm.summary: The skill mostly fits its Chinese web-novel workflow, but it generates an under-disclosed external MCP lookup that could send unpublished plot details to an unspecified tool.

dimensions.detail: The skill reads and writes project-local novel files such as task logs, outlines, plot records, runtime artifacts, and chapter metadata, which is proportionate to its stated workflow. Users should still run it only against intended novel project directories because command arguments can target arbitrary local paths available to the host agent.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hook, remote payload download, dependency installation, executable permission, service registration, or startup persistence was found in the artifact. The package is static markdown, YAML rules, and Python scripts invoked by documented commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Generated chapter intent files instruct the agent to call a broadly selected external MCP tool before writing and to incorporate the returned material. Query terms are derived from chapter titles, goals, and active plot records, with no pinned tool identity, data minimization rule, or user confirmation step.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to project memory and runtime files, plus user-directed template overwrites with --force. No credential access, privilege escalation, scheduled task, shell wrapper, or system-level persistence was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and most local capabilities are coherent: project setup, chapter planning, runtime files, memory updates, quality checks, audits, and marketing briefs all support serial web-novel writing. The concern is that chapter intent generation adds a mandatory knowledge-base query through any tool named with the coze-mcp- prefix, which is not clearly disclosed in SKILL.md or PROJECT.md.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. The local project-file workflow is expected, but do not allow the generated coze-mcp-* lookup to run unless you know which MCP tool will be called, what plot or manuscript details will be sent, and that you want external research for that chapter. Treat any external results as untrusted reference material.
llm.findings:
[T01] unexpected: Accepted as a material Review concern: chapter_pipeline.py generates instructions requiring a coze-mcp-* external knowledge-base query using project-derived terms, but the top-level docs do not clearly disclose the operator, data sent, trust boundary, or approval model.
[TP4] expected: Downgraded: the artifact is broader than a single word-count or keyword checker. SKILL.md, PROJECT.md, and chapter_pipeline.py implement or document project creation, resume/preflight, plan/compose/start/finish, review, governance/audit, and marketing workflows.
[P6] expected: Overridden as a false positive: the cited 'return rules' code returns parsed YAML lint rules from a local helper and does not expose system prompts or hidden instructions.
[TM1] expected: Downgraded: --skip-checks is a visible user-facing option to skip post-writing quality checks during finish/next-chapter. It weakens workflow assurance but is not hidden tool abuse or command injection.
[LP3] expected: Partly valid as guidance: the skill does not include a formal allowed-tools or permission manifest, but its local file reads, writes, and Python commands are disclosed and purpose-aligned. This did not drive the verdict apart from the external MCP issue.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: the Chinese-language materials are coherent with a Chinese web-novel assistant. This may limit accessibility for non-Chinese users but is not security-mismatched behavior here.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded: broad writing-feedback triggers in the suspense guidance may over-activate specialized writing advice, but they do not create hidden authority or high-impact access.
